[Procurement Department Special-Channel Acquisitions List]

Rosin, violin cleaner and maintenance kit—Leithanien—Cost: ■■■■, Price: -
Amiya has picked up her violin a good deal more often since we got back from Zelgrad. It's a relief to see. She always used to say that violin of hers didn't need an expensive maintenance kit, and I didn't know any better myself. It took asking several Leithanien Operators before I learned that no matter what the instrument itself is like, careful upkeep is never the wrong call. Now that this whole Ursus business is behind us, she has earned a proper reward too.

Bound newspaper volumes, assorted—the nations of Terra—Cost: ■■■■, Price: -
Fully automatic scanning equipment and reader—Kazimierz—Cost: ■■■■, Price: -
Kal'tsit hasn't said so, but she absolutely wants to know what has been happening across Terra all this time.
The scanner and the reader can count as gifts from me. Kazimierz manufacturers do still turn out something useful now and then, and a scanner that turns the pages, scans, and files everything by itself is not easy to find anywhere else in Terra... even if it does feel like something invented by some desperate secretary.

Smart-conversion components for a hot water kettle—Columbia—Cost: ■■■■, Price: -
I call it a smart conversion; what it actually meant was buying an entire Tkaronto-made smart water purifier and working out how to graft its components onto a kettle, because there is simply no such thing as a 'smart kettle' to be had anywhere—how do Columbians not appreciate a good hot water kettle!
Hold on. What exactly is good about a hot water kettle?
...Never mind. The point is that this kettle now takes voice commands, controls its own water temperature, and pours filtered cold water straight out—roughly a miniaturized water purifier, in other words. Like it or not, it belongs to the Doctor now.

Handheld Game Development Master V10.0—Higashi (Southern Court)—Cost: ■■■■, Price: -
...

Those who received the gifts worried that Closure had been so busy she had forgotten herself, so each of them prepared a gift in return and went together to thank her. The worry turned out to be unnecessary. When they reached the Engineering Department, Closure was slumped over her desk, fast asleep, and beside her sat a small trophy in a style very much her own.
